# Psychowellness Center

> > A comprehensive mental health clinic in Delhi offering evidence-based counselling, therapy, and child psychology services through qualified psychologists and therapists.

Psychowellness Center is a mental health practice with multiple locations across Delhi NCR (Dwarka, Janakpuri, West Delhi) providing clinical psychology services, specialized treatment programs, and internship opportunities. The center utilizes evidence-based therapeutic approaches including CBT, DBT, and ACT for various mental health conditions affecting children and adults.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT)
- ADHD Treatment
- Autism Spectrum Disorder
- Anxiety Disorders
- Depression Counselling
- Trauma and PTSD
- Child Psychology
- Stress Management
- Learning Disabilities
- Relationship Counseling
- Emotional Wellness
- Psychological Assessment
- Mindfulness-Based Therapy

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://www.psychowellnesscenter.com/our-services): Overview of therapy services including CBT, DBT, ACT, and mindfulness-based approaches for mental health conditions.
- [Anxiety Treatment in Delhi](https://www.psychowellnesscenter.com/service-anxiety-treatment-in-delhi): Service page explaining anxiety symptoms, types like GAD and panic disorder, and treatment options.
- [Depression Counselling in Delhi](https://www.psychowellnesscenter.com/service-depression-counselling-delhi): Service page for depression counselling using CBT, IPT, and MBCT therapies by expert psychologists.
- [Stress Counselling in Delhi](https://www.psychowellnesscenter.com/service-stress-counselling-delhi): Stress counselling service page featuring CBT and mindfulness-based stress management techniques.
- [Trauma Counselling in Delhi](https://www.psychowellnesscenter.com/service-trauma-counselling-delhi): Trauma counselling service page covering PTSD treatment and trauma recovery with evidence-based therapy.

## Child & Developmental Services
